book.name: Galɛshiaŋ
book.title: Ŋwa wù Bol gɛ̀ saŋ fɛ kintaashɛ ki Galɛshiaŋ le

content: Bamii ba Nyo fîih bamii bachii

Booŋ ba bwɛɛŋ, nɛ bɛŋ ja bɛŋ yɛŋ muh mu a bɛŋ ntɛnɛɛ wu gwe yi kimbefɛ le, bɛŋ ba chee kinche no Kiyo ki Nyo duunyi, bɛŋ môŋ ki bɛŋ têfɛ wu wu bû a kimbefɛ kiyu ntɛŋ. Geenɛ, muh doo wu teefe wu teefe wɛɛ wu yɛ̂ne lɛ keefɛ wu tɛ lêe mmoŋ le wu gwê gɛ.
Bɛŋ fîih booŋ ba bwe wene bɛ baŋgɛ baboo. Nɛ bɛŋ gee noo tu bɛŋ gɛɛde nchi wu Kletu.
Nɛ muh jode kikwɛɛ ke lɛ wu le fiɛɛ, njɛ wu le fiɛɛ sɛŋ, tu wu lɛɛde gɛh nyu bɛ kikwɛɛ ke.
Muh wuchii tâa gee che, wu yɛ̂ŋ laa wu gee chuule la. Nɛ wu gee chuule, fɛ wu chîaase ye fɛ kikwɛɛ ke le. Geenɛ keefɛ wu fêge kikwɛɛ ke bɛ muh mu gɛ.
Bɛŋ kêe lɛ muh wuchii kɛme ki wu tûude we ntɛ.
Nɛ muh yɛyi muh bɛ jɛ yi Nyo, muh wù ba yɛyi wu gâdɛ mwɛɛ mwe mù njoŋe munchii, wu nyâ muh wù yɛyi wu yu.
Keefɛ bɛŋ lɛ̂ɛde bɛ bikwɛɛ biɛna gɛ. Gɛ Nyo nyu kiyuŋ gɛ. Bɛŋ kêe lɛ fiɛɛ fì muh bone le gɛh fi fì wu lé wu gê wu gwêjɛ.

Nɛ muh bone ye ŋgo nyu fiɛɛ fì nyaŋ yi ye ye goone, tu wu lé wu gê wu gwêjɛ gɛh nyu fiɛɛ fì nyaŋ yi ye ye nyaa, fì le kwe. Nɛ muh bone ye ŋgo nyu fiɛɛ fì Kiyo ki Nyo goone, tu wu lé wu gê wu gwêjɛ kinche kì kage gɛ kì Kiyo ki Nyo nyaa.
Noo, keefɛ besabɛŋ gê be wɛ̂ɛyi ki be gêe mwɛɛ mù njoŋe gɛ, nje kife le ki tô ki kôjɛ kì bee kɛ̂mɛ ŋgwejɛ wuyu fɛ bee baaŋ fwɛɛŋ gɛ.
Fi mo fi nyu lɛ, yi kife le kichii kì besabɛŋ kɛme je, bee gêe gɛh mwɛɛ mù njoŋe fɛ bamii le bachii tete fɛ bobaa bò le a kfuu chi bamii ba mbɛmɛ le.
Njɛmɛ wù fɛkimɛsɛ
Bɛŋ yɛŋ no ajii a ŋwa a fɛnɛ le a kuge! Saŋ mɛ bɛ kibo kaŋ.

Bamii baa bò kaane lɛ ba chvûse bɛŋ yeh le bo bò goone ki bo chîaase ye yi mwɛɛ mu nyaŋ yi ye le. Bo gee noo wu lɛ keefɛ bamii gê bo bôone bikaa a bo jiŋ nje fiɛɛ fì bo feeji lɛ Kletu gɛ̀ kwe yi kintaaŋ le.
Mo bamii ba ba le ba chvuu wa bo yeh, gɛ bo gɛɛde banchi bachii gɛ. Geenɛ bo goone lɛ sege ba chvuu bɛŋ yeh bo mo bo kfûune gvuu lɛ bɛŋ le bɛŋ ge fiɛɛ fì bo goone yi ye yene le.

Geenɛ, fɛ mɛne gɛ mɛ nyu n'yu ntô ŋkfûuŋ gvuu yi fiɛɛ fimi le fuge yi saaka wu lɛ Tada wese besabɛŋ wù Jiso Kletu gɛ kwe yi kintaaŋ le. Le yi kintaaŋ kinɛ le wù mwɛɛ mu yi nshɛŋ le, le mu kwe wa mu gasɛ besa mu, ŋgasɛ tɛ bɛ mu.
Nɛ muh le yu wù ba le ba chvuu wu yeh kɛnɛ ba baaŋ wu yeh chvuu gɛ, tu gɛ fifiɛɛ kɛme fiɛɛ ki fi gê gɛ. Fiɛɛ fì le fishaŋ le lɛ, Nyo sêesɛ muh, wu nyûme muh wù fwɛŋ.
Kimbonɛ ki Nyo bɛ yii ye tô fɛ bamii bachii ba bii je yinɛ le, bò le wa bamii ba Ishwala ba Nyo.
Kɛge mɛɛse gɛɛne lo, keefɛ muh ka wu fûuŋse mɛ gɛ, nje banlelɛ ba le yi ye yaŋ le duunyi lɛ nle muh wu Jiso.
Booŋ ba bwɛɛŋ, Tada wese besabɛŋ wù Jiso Kletu dûnyɛ fitele fì joŋe fɛ biyo biɛna le. Fi nyûme noo.
